```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ON (pois.poi_name)
    pois.poi_name,
    pois.amenity,
    pois.cuisine,
    pois.addr_state,
    pois.addr_city
FROM pois
WHERE pois.amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND pois.cuisine = 'american'
  AND pois.id NOT IN (
      SELECT pois.id
      FROM pois
      JOIN parks ON ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, parks.geometry::geography, 90000)
      UNION
      SELECT pois.id
      FROM pois
      JOIN lakes ON ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, lakes.geometry::geography, 90000)
      UNION
      SELECT pois.id
      FROM pois
      JOIN roads ON ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, roads.geometry::geography, 90000)
  )
  AND ST_DWithin(
      pois.geometry::geography,
      (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dudley House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Ventura%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1),
      90000
  )
ORDER BY pois.poi_name, pois.geometry <-> (
    SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dudley House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Ventura%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1
) ASC;
```
